verdicts.proof: Old: TextButton Skip -> _skip under the shutter (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1022-1027) and Skip in the error overlay (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1102-1108); _skip (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:611-619) advances or calls _finalize, which asks get_docs_gate_checklist and shows 'docsScanIncomplete' + missing list (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:648-656). v2 entry points: ScanControlsV2 Skip (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_camera_v2.dart:125, wired at lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:990 onSkip: _skip) and ScanResultV2 Skip (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:134, wired at lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1149 onSkip: _skip). Both call the same _skip -> same _finalize; no other v2 path skips a side.

uploadDocPhoto succeeds only when save-verification-document returns success==true and document_id != null (document_provider.dart:512-518); _capture marks the side done only if uploadOk (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:282-303), else error/contactFallback by attempt counter (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:304-333). This logic is look-independent; v2 only renders _resultKind via _resultOverlayV2 (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1128-1150) -> ScanResultV2 ok heading 'Doklad úspěšně naskenován' vs warn 'Sken se nepovedl' (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:100,112).

Old: when OCR fields are missing but the photo is stored, message = docPhotoSavedNoOcr (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:295-298) with success kind. v2: ScanResultV2 ok=true splits message by lines; this text has no 'label: ' prefix in the checked languages (translations_ext_4_docscan.dart:7-25), so it is shown as a note line (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:95,119-122) under the green tone disc and heading, followed by the single Continue button. Same text, same body-text level as the old overlay.

didChangeAppLifecycleState (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:188-197) and _disposeCamera (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:204-212) are in the State class above any look branch; v2 camera screen reads the same _cam/_camReady (preview condition at lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:916-919 is shared by both looks). No v2-specific camera lifecycle code exists.

Old: title + 'side n/total' and _progressDots (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:962-976, :1261-1271). v2: ScanTopV2 gets step '${title} · ${side}', index=_stepIdx, total=_sequence.length (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:955-960) and shows the chip 'step n/total' (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_camera_v2.dart:39) plus one segment per side, done/current in neon (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_camera_v2.dart:50-65). Same values, shown as clearly.

No camera: _camError='cameraNotAvailable', _camFe=null (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:144-151). v2: when MgV2.on && _camError != null the whole step screen is ScanCameraErrorV2 (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:905-913) with onSettings=null -> primary 'Zkusit znovu' (_retryCamera), secondary 'Zpět' (_closeScanner), back arrow via MgStateScreen onClose closeIsBack (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:243-255; mg_state_screen.dart:136-140,188). Warn camera disc + heading 'Kameru teď nejde spustit' + the same reason text. No capture is reachable (shutter is not built).

Permission denied: FriendlyError permission -> errCameraPermission (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:167-179); old settings button only if fe.needsSettings (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:860-864). v2 passes onSettings only when fe != null && fe.needsSettings (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:909) -> primary 'Otevřít nastavení' (openFixSettings), secondary Retry, top back arrow (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:252-255). Same condition, same handlers, heading + reason.

Old shows eoScanUseGallery as a small grey line (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:855-858). v2 shows the same key as the single step under the heading 'Jak to vyřešit' (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:248-249), more prominent than before.

Resume re-inits the camera only if _camError == null (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:195); only _retryCamera clears it (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:882-887). The v2 error screen is driven by the same _camError (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:905) and its Retry calls the same _retryCamera; nothing in v2 clears _camError otherwise.

Old: result overlay is the last Stack child with a 0.85 black ColoredBox, single button ok?_onContinue (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1036-1110). v2: same Stack slot (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1027-1028), ScanPanelV2 has a Positioned.fill ColoredBox scrim (opaque hit-test) over everything incl. the top back arrow, plus a bottom panel without drag-dismiss (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:35-64); success branch shows only Continue -> _onContinue (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:117-124). Shutter/Skip controls are not built while _resultKind != none (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:986). Scrim is lighter (0.55) so the camera is faintly visible but not usable.

Old: 'Zbývá pokusů: n' when !ok && remaining>0, Retry (_onRetry), Skip (_skip) (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1081-1108). v2: remaining = _kMaxAttemptsPerStep - _resultAttempt (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1146), attempts chip when !ok && remaining>0 next to the warn disc (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:101-105), Retry -> onRetry, Skip -> onSkip (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:132-134). After the 3rd failure both looks switch to the help panel (ScanHelpV2, lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:1131-1141).

_buildFailureReason / _buildErrorMsg / _guidanceForStep are shared (lib/features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:366-480). v2 shows the reason with emoji stripped as body text (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:126) and the guidance as up to 3 steps (lib/features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart:96,127-130). Guidance keys are single paragraphs in all checked languages (translations_ext_33_docscan_a/b.dart), so take(3) drops nothing; ocr_failed/no_fields reasons with '\n\n' hints stay in the one Text widget. Headline 'Sken se nepovedl' is added; the distinction itself is still in body text as before.
